meaningOfPassed: The import/execution/report workflow and independent arithmetic checks passed; the numerical fit verdict is recorded separately below.
checks: Published CSV and frozen spatial-protocol SHA-256 digests match the pinned provenance before import
Real 60 fps source videos yield 52 training and 49 validation mask-centroid observations, with exact CSVs retained and measured classification explicitly qualified
Visible controls execute the frozen 0..1 friction search, 1 s native runs, 0.015 m tolerance and 0.001 m minimum gain without tuning to the validation outcome
Every training candidate is a retained 240-tick native run; RMSE is independently recomputed from native samples and the real observation timestamps
All four baseline/fitted training/validation RMSE and maximum residuals independently match exact source-frame-aligned native samples
The actual verdict equals the declared gates; a rejection disables Apply and is not rewritten into success
Research leaves both authored surrogate scenes at version 1; no automatic parameter promotion
Actual HTML/SVG/CSV/JSON report opens in the existing canvas and passes three DOM assertions with the original observation CSVs
No renderer JavaScript errors during real-data import, native fit or report

protocol.method: Largest mask component >127; centroid projected onto training first-to-last line
protocol.timeOrigin: First source frame; each run uses its own first-frame spatial origin
protocol.rows: All source frames, no smoothing, no fitted time shift or velocity correction
protocol.apply: Research only; no automatic application, even if numerical gates pass
assumptions: Shared camera/projection and constant image-plane scale across these two recordings
Training endpoint uses a reported 0.726 m travel constraint; not independent endpoint validation
Mask centroids are estimated from real recordings, not raw position-sensor measurements
Nominal 20 degrees; image perspective and release timing have unresolved uncertainty
Native 12 m ramp, 0.5 m cube and 1 kg are surrogate assumptions, not measured apparatus

evaluation.criteria: training RMSE gain >= declared minimum; every validation residual <= tolerance; validation RMSE does not increase beyond 1e-9 m numerical slack
evaluation.scope: Parameter calibration in the recorded native model; source labels are user supplied, prior validation uses recorded, and collection independence not proven

selection.criterion: minimum executed training RMSE; ties prefer the existing parameter

definition.method: native-grid-v1: 9 coarse values, two four-point refinements; training RMSE only
